notes: Modified cash basis village audit. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement, Total Governmental Funds 2023 column (p6; fund columns p5). Taxes 149,601 split by the Schedule 2 Totals column (p11: property 57,463, motor vehicle 12,424, sales 79,714; nonmajor funds have no taxes); Intergovernmental revenues 65,888 split by the same column. Bond principal/interest payments and sale of assets are printed under Other financing sources (uses) and recorded in other_financing. Beginning/ending cash = Exhibit C total assets 2022/2023 (p4, cash in bank + fire hall + county treasurer); fund balances 137,787 / 135,326 from p6. Business-type from the proprietary funds statement (Exhibit H p8; agrees with the Statement of Activities p2), modified cash net position measure; receipts total = operating 69,471 + interest 132. Proprietary cash flows from Exhibit I (p9; capital and related = purchase of capital assets, no net line printed). Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (capital assets and debt present). Detail: Schedule 2 (major funds; Debt Service fund had no activity) and Schedule 4 (nonmajor) per fund; Exhibit H proprietary lines per fund. Schedule 5 (combined budget, fund totals only) and Schedule 6 (proprietary budgetary, same lines as Exhibit H) not recorded to avoid double counting. Read pages 1-14 of 14
